name: Menethil Statuette
summary: Off the Wetlands coast, the Menethil Statuette lies lost from a shipwreck. The rare silver likeness honors Lordaeron's fallen king.

sections.title: A Rare Relic of Lordaeron
sections.body: King Terenas Menethil II is shown as a young paladin, long-haired, with his hammer raised toward the heavens. Humble in life, he disliked monuments to himself, and few likenesses were made in his honor. When the Scourge brought down Lordaeron, almost all those likenesses were destroyed. This surviving effigy is precious to the Alliance.

sections.title: Loss in the Bogs
sections.body:
The Blind Princess was carrying the statuette toward the Alliance harbor of Menethil when Bluegill murlocs attacked off the marshy coast. The assault scattered the merchant vessel's cargo, and the statuette came to rest in a half-buried barrel on shore.

Dragonmaw orcs and other local threats remained nearby, so defenders hurried the recovered icon south to Stormwind City. There, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon entrusted it to the Cathedral of Light.

faq.q: Who is shown on the statuette?
faq.answer: The statuette shows King Terenas Menethil II, former ruler of Lordaeron and architect of the original Alliance. He appears as a young paladin raising a warhammer.
The Blind Princess carried the statuette across the Great Sea. Bluegill murlocs attacked the ship in the Wetlands, and its cargo washed ashore and was buried in the mud.

faq.q: Why are depictions of King Terenas so rare?
aliases: why are there few statues of terenas
faq.answer: King Terenas disliked memorials that praised himself, so few statues of him were made. The Scourge's devastation of Lordaeron destroyed almost all the portraits and figures that remained in the north.

faq.q: Where does the statuette end up?
aliases: where do i take the statuette
faq.answer: After its recovery in the Wetlands, the statuette is brought to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep. He recognizes the Light within the relic and entrusts it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker at the Cathedral of Light.

angles.text: As a paladin, you see King Terenas as a young warrior of the Light, his hammer raised. His portrait speaks to holy knights who mourn the fallen kingdom.
As an Alliance member, you know Terenas as the unifying leader who founded the Grand Alliance. Any memorial of him that survives is an inspiring treasure in a fractured world.
